'''Noren Krast''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked for the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] and thought of himself as one of their "bigwigs" during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He lived in [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]], a [[City/Legends|city]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] that was sympathetic to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. It is unknown if he shared this allegiance.
